title: Registered customer can search for a product and add it to bag
description: As a registered customer, I want to search for a product by keyword, open a product detail page, choose an available size, and add the item to my shopping bag so that I can proceed toward checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can search for a product using the site header search bar
Search results display relevant products for the entered keyword
Customer can open a product detail page from search results
Customer can select an available product size
Customer can add the selected product to the shopping bag
Shopping bag count or basket surface updates after adding the product
If no size is selected, the customer sees a clear validation message
